hook: Finding the shortest vector in some structured lattices is NP-complete, shown by a reduction from Subset Sum.
summary: The authors prove that exact shortest-vector decision in the l-infinity norm is NP-complete for principal ideals and rank-two free modules over power-of-two cyclotomic rings, which are lattice structures used in cryptography. They give a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from Subset Sum and extend it to related cyclic rings. The result concerns exact solutions in one norm, so it does not break or certify any cryptosystem.
title: $\mathsf{SVP}_\infty$ Is NP-Hard for Power-of-two Cyclotomic Ideals
